name: Plumbing Pipe Repair

faqs.question: Can you repair pipes without replacing them?
faqs.answer: In many cases yes, we can repair pipes using epoxy lining, pipe clamps, or sectional replacement depending on the damage extent.

faqs.question: What causes pipe leaks?
faqs.answer: Common causes include corrosion, freezing, high water pressure, age, ground shifting, and physical damage from construction or tree roots.

faqs.question: Do you repair all types of pipes?
faqs.answer: Yes, we repair copper, PVC, PEX, galvanized steel, and cast iron pipes using appropriate methods for each material.

faqs.question: How long do pipe repairs last?
faqs.answer: Quality pipe repairs can last 10-20+ years depending on the repair method, pipe material, and water conditions.

faqs.question: Should I repair or replace old pipes?
faqs.answer: We assess pipe condition and provide honest recommendations. Isolated damage often warrants repair, while widespread corrosion may require repiping.

faqs.question: Can you repair frozen pipes?
faqs.answer: Yes, we thaw frozen pipes safely and repair any burst sections, plus recommend freeze prevention measures.

faqs.question: Do you offer emergency pipe repair?
faqs.answer: Yes, we provide 24/7 emergency pipe repair services for burst pipes and major leaks to prevent water damage.

description: Professional pipe repair services for leaks, cracks, and damaged plumbing lines
